offers.title: RedBus Fest Offer
offers.description: Flat 10% off on AC and overnight bus tickets for selected routes.
offers.rules: Applicable on first-time bookings with valid promo code.

offers.title: HSBC Rail Discount
offers.description: Exclusive savings on premium sleeper and AC coach bookings for HSBC card users.
offers.rules: Use card-linked discount on eligible routes during the campaign period.

offers.title: Weekend Voyage
offers.description: 10% instant discount on weekend travel for state-to-state routes.
offers.rules: Valid for bookings made on Friday to Sunday departures.

offers.title: Sleeper Saver
offers.description: Extra cashback on sleeper buses for long-distance overnight journeys.
offers.rules: Minimum fare constraint applies; best for overnight premium sleeper trips.

offers.title: First Trip Booster
offers.description: New user special on initial bus booking for festival and interstate travel.
offers.rules: Applies to the first booking only and may require valid new-user signin.

offers.title: Route 500
offers.description: Flat ₹500 off on selected high-traffic routes for travel over 400 km.
offers.rules: Only valid on bookings above the minimum fare threshold and selected route corridors.
